request.spec:
A period can be closed. Closing fixes its due-total at that moment: later changes to rates do not
alter it. No claim dated inside a closed period can be added, edited, opened, settled or voided;
each is refused with an error. Show closed yes/no on the period. Closing writes PERIOD_CLOSED
period=<name> total=<due-total>.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A period can be closed. Closing fixes its due-total at that moment: later changes to rates do not
alter it. No claim dated inside a closed period can be added, edited, opened, settled or voided;
each is refused with an error. Show closed yes/no on the period. Closing writes PERIOD_CLOSED
period=<name> total=<due-total>.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Periods can now be closed, and all 4 Playwright tests pass under `bin/e2e`.

**Stored data:** a new migration, `V14__period_closed.sql`, adds a `closed` flag and a `closed_total` column to each period.

**Server:**
- **Close endpoint:** `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/periods/{periodId}/close` adds up the due-total of the period's open and settled claims, using the same figures as the rest of the sheet. It stores that total and writes `PERIOD_CLOSED sheet=… by=… period=<name> total=<total>` to the audit file.
- **Refusals:** closing a period that is already closed, or one that isn't on the sheet, is refused and writes nothing.
- **Claim lock:** a claim dated inside a closed period is refused when it is added, edited, opened, settled or voided. For an add, a blank date counts as the sheet's today. An edit is also refused if it would move a claim's date into a closed period.

**Front end:**
- **Period row:** each period now shows `period-closed` (yes/no), a `period-close` button and a `period-error`. A closed period shows its stored total, so later rate changes don't change it; an open period still works its total out live.
- **Claim errors:** the existing `claim-error` and `claim-form-error` messages now also mention closed periods.

There is no way to reopen a closed period, because the request didn't ask for one.
